20 years after a devastating war, an old man and a young boy named Conan live on Remnant Island; one day, Conan finds a girl named Lana on the shore; when Lana is abducted by soldiers, Conan and his grandfather must spring into action.
Conan travels by plane and sea as he tries to rescue Lana from the clutches of Industria soldiers.
Conan arrives on a small island and meets Jimsy, a boy who has been living in the wild; as Conan gets to know his new friend, the ship Barracuda offers an opportunity to finally reach Industria.
Conan and Jimsy attempt to stow away aboard the Barracuda, but are caught and punished by the ship's captain Dyce; they get to work as the ship heads for Industria.
The Barracuda finally arrives in Industria and Conan and Jimsy are stunned to find it bleak and deserted; Conan races through the complex searching for Lana.
Conan and Lana are finally reunited but the villainous Lepka continues to pursue them; shocked by Lepka's brutality, Captain Dyce's allegiances begin to shift.

A ghostly painter with the ability to trap souls within his work has reawakened, and not even the other ghosts of the old schoolhouse want anything to do with him; Satsuki and the gang travel back in time in order to put the artist back to sleep.

Convinced that a ghost is haunting a train crossing, Leo takes the gang out to try and catch the spirit in a photo; when one of those photos shows a strange hand on Momoko's shoulder, things start getting bad, and a tale of revenge unfolds.

Satsuki falls in with a coven; several girls at school conspire to cast spells together, and she reluctantly joins; but when one of them goes missing, and no one seems to remember the girl's very existence, Satsuki knows this isn't any ordinary fad.

Following an accident on the job, Satsuki's father is injured, but Leo thinks ghosts are behind it; when the gang investigates the building Satsuki's father worked at, they find that the building itself is alive and eager to have guests stay.
